name: Morning Grace Mobile-First Layout
principles: phone layout is composed independently from desktop
primary task appears before decorative artwork
compact grouped rows replace large desktop cards
48px-class top app bar and 60px-class bottom tab bar
touch targets remain at least 44px where primary interaction requires it
desktop and tablet Morning Grace layouts remain unchanged
Morning Grace visual identity remains intact without oversized editorial hero treatment
phone landscape remains in the mobile app composition
root tabs and pushed detail workflows use different mobile navigation chrome

chrome.topBar: root destinations use a compact sticky title bar with Search and Data; pushed routes use a 44px contextual Back control plus route title
chrome.appearance: moved from phone app bar to Data/Settings
chrome.bottomNavigation: four compact fixed tabs on Today, Bible, Prayer and History only; hidden during pushed/detail workflows
chrome.immersiveTasks: active Focused Prayer removes outer app chrome while empty and finished states retain pushed navigation

screens.today: compact morning header + grouped four-reading list + two small response cards
screens.bible: reading-first; no chapter artwork on phone; compact sticky book/chapter controls; bottom verse actions
screens.prayer: compact header, small primary action, inline session-depth choice, horizontal status tabs, dense request rows
screens.history: compact header and segmented tabs, three-column factual summary, dense calendar
screens.secondary: stacked pushed workspaces with app-bar Back navigation, no duplicate visual H1, no root bottom tabs, and compact task-first spacing

secondaryNavigation.behavior: hide root bottom tabs and Search/Data utility actions; expose contextual Back navigation
secondaryNavigation.returnContext: prefer validated explicit return targets and devotional source context; otherwise use the nearest logical root
secondaryNavigation.safeAreas: app bars, sticky editor actions and immersive prayer account for device insets
